headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 18, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, winning 10-0 behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Jake Bennett led the way for the Red Sox, throwing 6.0 innings with 3 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Justin Sterner has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Athletics due to a right knee chondromalacia. Lourdes Gurriel Jr. has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Arizona Diamondbacks with a right adductor strain. Other notable injured players include Jeff Criswell (Colorado Rockies), Sal Frelick (Milwaukee Brewers), Oneil Cruz (Pittsburgh Pirates), Chris Bassitt (Baltimore Orioles), and JoJo Romero (St. Louis Cardinals).

The MLB trade market has been active, with several notable deals. The Athletics traded RHP Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for RHP Aiden Moffett. The Baltimore Orioles acquired RF Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash. The St. Louis Cardinals received RHP Trey Pooser from the Tampa Bay Rays. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded for CF Robert Hassell III from the Washington Nationals for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers acquired RHP Lance McCullers Jr., LHP Colton Gordon, and cash from the Houston Astros for OF Jadyn Fielder.

top_news.title: **Rays Suffer 10-0 Shutout Loss to Red Sox**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, winning 10-0 behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Jake Bennett led the way for the Red Sox, throwing 6.0 innings with 3 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Red Sox in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 3-5 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, handing their opponents their latest loss. Wilyer Abreu led the Rays' offense with a pair of home runs and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Edge Yankees in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured a narrow win over the New York Yankees, finalizing the score at 2-1. Max Muncy led the Dodgers' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Braves Rout Rangers 15-1**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Texas Rangers, securing a 15-1 victory. Drake Baldwin led the Rangers with 3 hits, including a home run and 5 RBIs, while Chris Sale earned the win for the Braves with 7 strong innings, striking out 6 and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Guardians 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Bryan Reynolds and Brandon Lowe leading the charge for their respective teams. Jared Jones and Gavin Williams stood out on the mound for the winning side.

top_news.title: **Cubs Cruise Past Twins 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing a 6-2 victory behind strong performances from Seiya Suzuki and Taj Bradley.

top_news.title: **Athletics RHP Justin Sterner Placed on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Athletics right-handed pitcher Justin Sterner has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right knee chondromalacia diagnosis.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Aaron Civale in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale in a trade with the Athletics. Civale joins the Cubs after being dealt for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett.
